answer: The ledge multiplier is published, charged in sonnet, and velvet lists each payment. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 13 for each account already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 3430 identities would post 2335 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
